extractor_notes: CRITICAL ENTITY-RESOLUTION FINDING: Jacobs Solutions Inc. completed the Reverse Morris Trust Separation Transaction on 2024-09-27, spinning off Critical Mission Solutions (CMS) and Cyber & Intelligence (C&I) into Amentum Holdings Inc. (AMTM). The defense work historically associated with Jacobs (hypersonic test infrastructure, NNSA Nuclear Security Enterprise sustainment, AF Test Range modernization) all moved to Amentum. The FY2025 10-K being scored is from POST-spin Jacobs (continuing operations only).
Continuing operations (I&AF + PA Consulting) end markets: Critical Infrastructure, Water & Environmental, Life Sciences & Advanced Manufacturing, plus PA Consulting.
U.S. federal government revenue dropped from 10% (FY24) to 8% (FY25) of continuing-operations revenue. No Pentagon programs are named in the continuing-operations narrative.

Search of the slice for 'hypersonic', 'NNSA', 'Nuclear Security Enterprise', 'AF Test Range', 'Air Force Test Range', 'Skyborg', 'CCA', 'Project Maven', 'PE 06...' returned ZERO matches. The cohort metadata referencing those programs reflects the PRE-spin Jacobs / current Amentum, not post-spin J.

Pentagon J-Book corpus by_entity shows 'Jacobs Technology Inc.' as performer on PE 0604879C (Ballistic Missile Defense Sensor Test, MDA) and 'Jacobs Technology IRES Inc.' as contractor on PE 0604102C (Guam Defense Development, MDA). These Jacobs Technology subsidiaries went with the CMS spin to Amentum; revenue from these PEs is no longer attributable to ticker J.

Because J no longer names DoD Program Elements in its 10-K, the J-BOOK DIVERGENCE PATTERN has limited surface area on this filing. The relevant J-Book signal is the ABSENCE of named-program disclosure, not divergence. We extract a small set of claims grounded in (a) the residual federal exposure that remains, (b) the dependency on the TSA / Amentum stock, and (c) end-market thesis claims to test orthogonally.

claims.claim_text: Jacobs completed the Separation Transaction on September 27, 2024, spinning off its Critical Mission Solutions (CMS) and Cyber & Intelligence (C&I) businesses, which were merged into Amentum (AMTM). CMS housed Jacobs' historical Pentagon program work (test ranges, hypersonic infrastructure, NNSA sustainment).
claims.subject: Jacobs Solutions Inc.
claims.source_quote: On September 27, 2024, Jacobs completed the previously announced Reverse Morris Trust transaction pursuant to which (i) Jacobs first transferred its Critical Mission Solutions business (CMS) and portions of the Divergent Solutions (DVS) business (referred to herein as the Cyber & Intelligence business (C&I)... Amentum, the surviving entity of the Separation Transaction, is now an independent public company with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol AMTM.
